fields.FIR_Description: As per the FIR recorded on 2025-05-21, a person allegedly threatened Kumaran Anand at Roja Park Main Street in Coimbatore and took a mobile phone. The time of the incident was given as 22:45 on 2025-05-21. The complaint was lodged by Elango Krishnan (9000000081) on behalf of Kumaran Anand, whose contact number is given as 9000000039. No independent witness was identified at the time of registration. No identifying details of the suspected person were available at the time of registration. A motorcycle bearing the number TN-38-YY-1022 was seen leaving the area. Items referenced in the complaint: a vehicle observation.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Victim allegedly intercepted and threatened before valuables were taken. A motorcycle was reportedly used to leave the area.
fields.Keywords: robbery, threat, main street, night, motorcycle, vehicle observation
